document.about: US EPA AP-42, Chapter 2.4, municipal solid waste landfills (2024, public domain). Its links are drawn with rectangles about twice the height of their line, one rectangle per line where an anchor wraps.

notes: The note marks in this document's tables are checked by the case epa-ap42-note-marks.

A rectangle around a short run of text holds more padding than text. Measured by area, its paragraph covered under half of it, and the link was dropped: the first line of a wrapped anchor, or a reference's URL on a line of its own.
